references.text: The prophecy that the Messiah will bring peace stands in contrast to Jesus' words that he did not come to bring peace, but a sword.
A psalm speaking about ruling among enemies can be seen in light of Jesus' words about not bringing peace, but a sword.
Zechariah prophesies about a sword against my shepherd and about division, which can be related to Jesus' words about bringing a sword.
Jesus warns of persecution and division as a result of his message, which is in line with the message in Matthew 10:34.
Paul speaks of spiritual warfare, which can be seen as a parallel to Jesus' words about not bringing peace, but a sword.
